My Beautiful and Kind Mrs. Rafiei,

I hope that when your beautiful eyes fall upon this page and these words, they bring you even the slightest bit of happiness and put a smile on your face.

I truly wish I could have celebrated Mother's Day with you in a different way, by giving you a gift and giving you a hug. Unfortunately, that isn't possible, but I have tried my best to find a special way to wish you a happy Mother's Day.

Without a doubt, you are the kindest, most caring, strongest, most beautiful, and most wonderful mother anyone could ever ask for.

I am certain that your children are proud to have a mother like you.

And I feel incredibly happy and lucky to have someone as extraordinary as you in my life, even if only for a chapter of it.

I love you more than words can express, and from the bottom of my heart, I wish that every single day of your life unfolds in a way that you truly wish for yourself.

Happy Mother's Day!

With all my love
